lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Cluster of high-intensity local maxima arranged in a semi-regular grid posterior to the fifth gill slit, with approximately 5-6 horizontal rows of luminance peaks visible across the mid-flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the high-luminance circular blobs, creating a structured checkerboard pattern of anchor nodes along the lateral surface.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Single prominent linear ridge running horizontally across the upper flank, defined by a sharp vertical gradient with high-luminance highlight on the dorsal edge and a high-contrast shadow on the ventral edge.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: A distribution of approximately 12-18 high-luminance circular clusters of varying size contained within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Visible indentation or irregular notch on the posterior trailing edge of the first dorsal fin; a dark, thin trailing appendage is visible extending from the ventral-lateral region posterior to the pectoral fin.
other_distinctive_markers: Multiple low-luminance silhouettes of smaller organisms (commensal fish) clustered beneath the ventral midline and near the caudal peduncle.
